title: Stress से सच में बाल सफ़ेद होते हैं? 😱
cover_text: Stress ने चूहों के बाल किए *सफ़ेद*!

cover.prompt: A single hair strand rising from glowing skin, the lower part pure bright white and the upper part jet black, a teal glow around the root, centre, large in frame, calm empty black space at the top, sharp focus, extreme macro shot

fact_check.weak: Fairly well known: many already believe stress turns hair white
